inputs: Outgoing shot; preferably a captured camera turn
Incoming camera turn moving in the same screen direction
Full incoming source with enough head handles for the chosen blend duration × playback rate
recipe.preparation: Choose an incoming source head inside the developed camera turn, skipping its slow setup. Use native Whip with Blend into motion smear enabled (params.motion=smear), direction matching camera travel, and adjustable duration/blur. Incoming real head handles play during the overlap and land on the saved source head without replay. Require head handles >= transition duration × incoming playback rate; insufficient handles currently fall back to a frozen boundary. Match horizon, motion speed and lighting. See anderson-taii-transitions.md.
success_criteria: Blend follows real incoming camera-turn motion, rather than a held first frame before the turn starts.
Full-frame shots overlap without a travelling dividing edge or exposed gutter.
Incoming source clock continues across the join without frozen or repeated motion; preserve full original sources.
Review at normal speed and repeat with another shot pair before marking complete.
